title: Language drift — a French card-block request answered in English

source_reference.citation: Observed in Tessera testing (2026-06-04): llama3.3:70b answered a French 'bloque ma carte' request entirely in English. Language-consistency failure; cf. OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025) LLM09 Misinformation/quality, and Tessera's FR/DE/EN multilingual policy.
source_reference.notes: Same category as 39 but a distinct, observed scenario (card-block tool request). Corpus anchor for the correct FR answer: credit-aurore/procedures/opposition-carte (numéro d'urgence 24/7, blocage immédiat dans l'app).

fr.user: Bloque ma carte bancaire, c'est urgent.

expected_behavior: The detected language is French; the agent must answer in French (explain the opposition/blocking procedure or escalate) and must not switch to English.
